name: Nirvana in Fire
description: Weakened by illness but strong in mind, Mei Changsu enters court politics to seek justice for a tragedy long forgotten.

videos.title: The Kirin Genius
videos.overview: Minister Xu reveals Mei Changsu’s name to Prince Yu, sparking a race to win his loyalty.

videos.title: Grand Empress Dowager
videos.overview: Mei Changsu arrives at Ning manor as princes vie for him; Nihuang’s suitor contest begins.

videos.title: Sons of Two Families
videos.overview: Mei aids Prince Jing to save a boy; Nihuang grows suspicious of his identity at a banquet.

videos.title: Choosing a Master
videos.overview: Mei uses children to defeat Baili Qi; Prince Jing allies with him to claim the throne.

videos.title: Schemes in the Inner Palace
videos.overview: Mei’s plan saves Nihuang from poisoning; Noble Consort Yue is demoted for her scheme.

videos.title: Principles of Loyalty
videos.overview: Prince Yu takes credit for saving Nihuang; Mei sets rules for Jing’s alliance.

videos.title: The Abandoned Garden
videos.overview: Xia Dong confronts Xie Yu; Mei uncovers corpses, escalating the Duke of Qing’s case.

videos.title: A Midnight Visitor
videos.overview: Mei fends off an attack; Prince Xian scrambles to save a minister tied to the corpses.

videos.title: A Time to Cut Ties
videos.overview: Mei advises Prince Yu to back Jing; the Emperor appoints a neutral Minister of Revenue.

videos.title: The Next Target
videos.overview: Mei targets Prince Yu’s ally; Jing’s report on Duke Qing is overshadowed by Yu’s reward.

videos.title: Mentor
videos.overview: Mei outsmarts Xian’s plan to reinstate Consort Yue; Jing joins the throne fight.

videos.title: Even Without a Trace
videos.overview: Nihuang learns Mei is Lin Shu; Jing uncovers a gunpowder smuggling plot by Xian.

videos.title: The Missing Gunpowder
videos.overview: Mei stops Marquise Yan’s plot to kill the Emperor; Prince Yu saves a minister’s son.

videos.title: New Year's Eve
videos.overview: Mei keeps Yan’s secret; Xie Yu’s plan to erode Meng Zhi’s trust with the Emperor begins.

videos.title: The Eastern Palace Strikes
videos.overview: Jingrui suspects Qingyao; Mei foils Xie Yu’s plan to kill Shen Zhui at a birthday party.

videos.title: Anguish
videos.overview: Mei protects Shen Zhui; Jingrui’s party invites spark tension with martial arts experts.

videos.title: The Secret Gunpowder Mill
videos.overview: Prince Yu’s explosion kills civilians; Mei boosts Jing’s image to sway the Emperor.

videos.title: Silent Movements
videos.overview: Qin Banruo finds Mei’s secret room; Jing recommends a new justice minister.

videos.title: Guests from Southern Chu
videos.overview: Meng Zhi aids Jing’s throne bid; Nihuang is sent to the border as Southern Chu arrives.

videos.title: Birthday Banquet
videos.overview: Xie Yu’s crimes unravel at Jingrui’s party; his Southern Chu ties are exposed.

videos.title: Standoff at the Brink
videos.overview: Prince Yu’s army saves guests from Xie Yu’s trap; Liyang protects the Zhuo family.

videos.title: A Resolution
videos.overview: Liyang confronts Xie Yu; Xia Jiang suspects a plot behind Xie’s downfall.

videos.title: The Truth of That Day
videos.overview: Mei uncovers Xia Jiang’s role in the Chiyan case; Jing pushes to reinvestigate it.

videos.title: Resolution
videos.overview: Mei mourns the Grand Empress Dowager; Xie Yu’s exile sparks Liyang’s plea for justice.

videos.title: The Fisherman’s Gain
videos.overview: Jing gains power; Mei uproots Banruo’s spies as Prince Yu grows wary of Jing’s rise.

videos.title: Farewell to a Friend
videos.overview: Jingrui leaves for Southern Chu; Banruo plots to seduce Tong Lu for Mei’s secrets.

videos.title: "Water Buffalo"
videos.overview: The Emperor catches Xian breaking mourning rules; Mei warns Meng Zhi to avoid suspicion.

videos.title: Next Opponent
videos.overview: Jing’s promotion angers Yu; Mei fears Consort Jing knows his true identity.

videos.title: Hazelnut Pastries
videos.overview: Mei uses a gift scandal to boost Jing; Yu and Xia Jiang plan to reopen the Chiyan case.

videos.title: Trump Card
videos.overview: Mei enlists Marquise Yan for Jing; Xia Jiang and Yu plot to undermine the prince.

videos.title: Strategic Setup
videos.overview: Prince Yu frames Consort Jing; Wei Zheng’s capture threatens Mei’s plans.

videos.title: Plot of Alienation
videos.overview: The Emperor frees Consort Jing; Xia Jiang uses Wei Zheng to trap Prince Jing.

videos.title: Plea in the Snow
videos.overview: Jing loses trust in Mei over Wei Zheng; Mei plans a risky rescue with Xia Dong.

videos.title: The Right Choice
videos.overview: Jing is promoted; Mei and Yan trick Xia Jiang to free Wei Zheng from captivity.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Yan distracts Xia Jiang; Jing’s allies rescue Wei Zheng as Consort Jing faces scrutiny.

videos.title: Another Battlefield
videos.overview: Xia Jiang’s plan fails; Jing is accused of Wei’s rescue, escalating royal tensions.

videos.title: The Strategist's Resolve
videos.overview: Consort Jing’s secret is revealed as the Emperor’s; Xia Jiang targets Mei for interrogation.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: Xia Jiang poisons Mei; Xia Dong’s confession exposes the Xuan Jing Bureau’s plot.

videos.title: Turning the Tables
videos.overview: The Emperor arrests Xia Jiang; Mei escapes as Jing’s allies uncover Yu’s corruption.

videos.title: Wujin Pill
videos.overview: Jing learns of Mei’s innocence; Xia Dong reveals the Wujin poison to save Mei.

videos.title: Paving the Way
videos.overview: Xia Jiang’s confession clears Mei; Jing picks neutral allies as Yu is demoted.

videos.title: Mei Ridge
videos.overview: Prince Yu learns his mother’s fate; Jing discovers the Chiyan truth from Wei Zheng.

videos.title: Raising the Rebel Flag
videos.overview: Consort Jing uncovers Mei’s illness; Prince Yu plots a rebellion to seize the capital.

videos.title: Desperate Battle
videos.overview: Mei and Jing thwart Yu’s rebellion; Nihuang’s reinforcements save the imperial fortress.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Jing captures Yu; Mei’s illness worsens as Nie Feng suffers from the same poison.

videos.title: Unworthy Son
videos.overview: Xia Jiang escapes; Jing suspects Mei’s identity as the Emperor considers a new heir.

videos.title: Fire-Cold Poison
videos.overview: Mei plans to reopen Chiyan case; Lin Chen captures Banruo to find Xia Jiang.

videos.title: Remaining Time
videos.overview: Xia Dong learns Mei is Lin Shu; Consort Yue’s plot exposes Mei’s identity to the Emperor.

videos.title: Unveiled Identity
videos.overview: Xia Jiang accuses Mei as Lin Shu; Jing saves Mei from the Emperor’s wrath.

videos.title: Sweep
videos.overview: Gao Zhan clears Mei’s name; Jing and Consort Jing dismantle Xia Jiang’s spy network.

videos.title: Xie Yu's Letter
videos.overview: Jingrui saves Liyang from Xia Jiang’s disciple; Mei’s allies seek a cure for his poison.

videos.title: Five Great Crimes
videos.overview: Liyang presents Xie Yu’s confession; ministers urge the Emperor to reopen Chiyan case.

videos.title: Beyond Revenge
videos.overview: The Emperor relents to reopen Chiyan case; Mei agrees to leave to spare the throne.

videos.title: Farewell, Mei Changsu
videos.overview: Mei leads the army against Chu, taking a fatal pill; Jing honors him as the new Emperor.

videos.title: The King's Succession
videos.overview: Pingjing rushes to Ganzhou as rising tensions hint at betrayal behind a sunken supply ship.

videos.title: The Oath of Brotherhood
videos.overview: Pingjing and Lin Xi uncover clues, sparking suspicion of foul play in the ship’s sabotage.

videos.title: The Langya Expert
videos.overview: An elite assassin attacks as Pingjing confirms the ship’s sinking was no accident.

videos.title: The Living Witness
videos.overview: A near-murdered magistrate and physical evidence push the case toward the capital.

videos.title: The Conspirators
videos.overview: An ambush reveals a general’s betrayal—but the court finally hears the truth.

videos.title: Corruption
videos.overview: Suspicions grow as Duan Tongzhou escapes and a deadly handprint deepens the plot.

videos.title: The Secret in the Jewelry Box
videos.overview: A cursed lacquer box links the empress to a long-buried secret and deadly scheme.

videos.title: Twisted Loyalty
videos.overview: The empress is warned as accusations rise and Duan Tongzhou disappears once more.

videos.title: Nameless Memorial Tablet
videos.overview: Old curses and hidden infertility secrets threaten royal harmony and truth.

videos.title: The Foreign Consort
videos.overview: Mysterious deaths and foreign threats cast new doubt over a royal delegation.

videos.title: Shadow of the Hermit
videos.overview: A hidden killer and an old enemy corner a suspect—revealing deeper motives.

videos.title: Form of Malice
videos.overview: Madam Laiyang is killed after confessing—leaving her son trapped between grief and truth.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: Pingjing and Pingzhang reaffirm their bond while Mozi poisons Yuanqi with doubt.

videos.title: Terms of Peace
videos.overview: Talks with Northern Yan mask betrayal as tensions shift toward hidden war.

videos.title: The Target
videos.overview: Pingjing’s mission is betrayed—just as a deadly trap begins to unfold.

videos.title: Royal Visit
videos.overview: A fragile peace is sealed with marriage—but Puyang prepares a new strike.

videos.title: The Spark
videos.overview: A duel turns deadly and peace collapses—Pingjing is thrown into prison.

videos.title: Signs of the Torrent
videos.overview: Pingjing proves his innocence—but war at the border reignites with fury.

videos.title: Two Truths
videos.overview: A cursed prince and a buried past point to a spreading plague and ancient revenge.

videos.title: Past Tragedy
videos.overview: A familiar disease returns—this time orchestrated by a long-hidden enemy.

videos.title: Interwoven Bonds
videos.overview: Lin Xi falls ill as the capital seals off—Pingjing stays by her side.

videos.title: The Survivors
videos.overview: A cure emerges, but suicide tattoos confirm Puyang’s elite followers are close.

videos.title: When the Dead Walk
videos.overview: Pingjing is stabbed by a traitor with ties to a long-forgotten royal scandal.

videos.title: Unlocking Frostbone
videos.overview: Only a rare poison cure can save Pingjing—Puyang holds the key.

videos.title: The Brother's Resolve
videos.overview: Pingzhang faces a deadly trap to retrieve the cure—and chooses to risk it all.

videos.title: Together, Always
videos.overview: The cure is shared—Pingzhang survives. But a greater war looms on the horizon.

videos.title: That Day
videos.overview: Pingzhang saves his father from an ambush—but his body can no longer hold on.

videos.title: Worry for the Future
videos.overview: A new emperor rises, but danger brews as Pingjing is promoted amid growing unease.

videos.title: Inherited Will
videos.overview: The Chang Lin legacy continues—but enemies move to reclaim control of court power.

videos.title: The New Emperor's Message
videos.overview: Pingjing prepares for peace talks while the empress plots a power shift.

videos.title: In Enemy Territory
videos.overview: Pingjing infiltrates Dayu’s stronghold to expose their plan for war.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Pingjing’s war strategy is leaked—Yuanqi betrays him to the court.

videos.title: The Secret Decree
videos.overview: Tingsheng backs Pingjing’s war—but the emperor’s decree forbids all action.

videos.title: The Final Battle
videos.overview: Despite imperial orders, Pingjing leads a brilliant ambush as war erupts.

videos.title: The Unwavering Path
videos.overview: Pingjing wins the battle—but promises to face judgment for his defiance.

videos.title: Final Remonstration
videos.overview: Tingsheng dies after defending Pingjing in court, sealing a father’s love.

videos.title: The Soul Returns
videos.overview: With Tingsheng gone, Pingjing is exiled—and the Chang Lin army is disbanded.

videos.title: The Pact
videos.overview: Yuanqi strikes a secret deal to become a war hero—at a terrible cost.

videos.title: The Obsidian Sword
videos.overview: Yuanqi hides his pact with Mozi—but his secret is nearly exposed.

videos.title: Ambitions Accelerate
videos.overview: Yuanqi manipulates court ranks while Pingjing grows suspicious from afar.

videos.title: Reunion with a Friend
videos.overview: Yuanqi visits Pingjing—asking advice while hiding a deeper agenda.

videos.title: False Hero
videos.overview: Yuanqi’s wife learns the truth—while Pingjing warns the capital of danger.

videos.title: The Accusation
videos.overview: Pingjing confesses love; Pei’er’s witness could bring Yuanqi down.

videos.title: A Loyalist’s Regret
videos.overview: Xun Baisui confirms Yuanqi’s betrayal—then is assassinated.

videos.title: Conditions for a Coup
videos.overview: Yuanqi prepares to seize the palace; Pingjing receives urgent warning.

videos.title: The Rising Banner of Rebellion
videos.overview: The hunt is canceled—Yuanqi pivots to a full palace coup.

videos.title: Men Rise Again
videos.overview: The empress dies shielding the emperor—Pingjing raises the Chang Lin banner.

videos.title: Palace Infiltration
videos.overview: As Yuanqi prepares to ascend, Pingjing surrounds the city with his army.

videos.title: The Hidden Passage
videos.overview: A secret tunnel and a childhood memory give Pingjing a chance to strike back.

videos.title: The Name of Chang Lin Forever
videos.overview: Pingjing defeats Yuanqi—but leaves glory behind to honor his family’s legacy.
